thread:
Sam: Following up on the security segment from the all-hands — a handful of customers and sales asked for clearer timelines and a single owner list for SOC2/ISO artifacts, BYO KMS, VPC/private connectivity patterns, and longer audit-log retention. Dropping notes here so we have a living thread.

Isha: Good call. Top-level plan: assemble an initial SOC2 evidence bundle (controls we can immediately demonstrate) then iterate for ISO gaps. BYO KMS is in active design review; aiming for a limited beta. Audit logs: we'll expose a tenant-level retention option up to 365 days behind a feature flag.

Jordan: Quick infra context: PrivateLink is the cleanest zero-egress option and our infra team will publish region service names + terraform module updates. We'll keep VPC peering as an escape hatch but its higher friction.

Maggie: For ISO mapping we need access review snapshots, KMS policy exports, and rotation history. If infra can export sample artifacts (redacted) we can template the evidence.

Kira: Proposed short DRIs & dates so legal/sales have something concrete: SOC2 initial evidence -> Isha + Kira -> 2026-06-12. BYO KMS beta -> Jordan + Sam -> 2026-05-22. Private connectivity doc (PrivateLink checklist + peering notes) -> Jordan -> 2026-05-03. Audit-log retention feature -> Kira + Jordan -> 2026-05-15.

Luis: Can we get a customer-facing one-pager for BYO KMS limitations (e.g., no cross-account HSM attestation yet)? That helps AE calls.

Isha: Yes, will draft a public FAQ and a technical appendix for BYO KMS integration points. Drafts by 2026-04-30.

Jordan: Technical snippet well include in the PrivateLink guide (example endpoint policy):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodPrivateAccess"},
      "Action": "execute-api:Invoke",
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

Security-Bot: Scan summary: 4 infra accounts flagged for missing explicit KMS key policy statements in the last 48h. Tickets created: INFRA-4901, INFRA-4902.

Maggie: Note for compliance: SOC2 wants documented rotation cadence and proof of KMS grant reviews. For customers using external HSMs with BYO KMS, well need an attestation template. Isha, can security draft that?

Isha: Yep — customer attestation + internal checklist for evidence ingestion. Sharing first drafts 2026-04-29.

Sam: Let's run weekly 30m office hours for commercial/compliance Qs until the SOC2 bundle is published. Proposed Wednesdays 10am PT. Jordan, can you set up the recurring invite?

Jordan: Ill schedule Wednesdays 10am PT and include security/legal.

Sam: Action recap (short):
- SOC2 initial bundle -> Isha + Kira -> 2026-06-12
- BYO KMS beta + public FAQ -> Jordan + Sam + Isha -> 2026-05-22 (FAQ draft 2026-04-30)
- PrivateLink + peering checklist -> Jordan -> 2026-05-03
- Audit-log retention feature -> Kira + Jordan -> 2026-05-15
- Weekly office hours Wednesdays 10am PT -> Jordan to schedule

Kira: Ill open a Confluence page with live status and link it here when ready. If anyone needs to swap DRI or move a date, reply in this thread so we can keep the page accurate. :thumbsup:
